description: Keeps pinned images, providers, actions and Ansible versions current; updates arrive as grouped pull requests, never merged automatically

packageRules.description: Images the team builds itself track :latest on purpose and redeploy through Portainer, so Renovate leaves them alone
Compose images: pin every third-party image by digest so updates arrive as reviewed changes
One weekly pull request for every image's minor, patch and digest updates; each docker/ stack redeploys on merge
A major image update gets its own pull request, since it may need config or data changes
Terraform providers, all projects together so they stay on one version
CI actions stay pinned by digest
The runner's Ansible pins and the CI workflow's copies move together, so CI checks what the runner runs; the workflow's actions keep their own group

customManagers.description: Python packages the runner installs (name==version list items); ansible-core is templated per Python version and stays manual
Ansible collections pinned as namespace.name:==version, on the runner and in CI
Python packages CI installs (pip install name==version ...)
The Terraform version CI checks with
